content.body:
The M1A2/M5 76.2 mm (3 inch) AT gun is the US 3 inch AA gun configured for anti-tank use. The gun was created in what could be seen as a hasty fashion when it became apparent that an anti-tank gun bigger than the M1A3/M1 (the US copy of the British QF 6 pounder AT gun) would be needed to take on the harder-to-kill next generation of German tanks. The original gun was crafted from the marriage of the existing 105 mm M2A1 howitzer with the 3" gun tube and shell chamber, grafted into the 105 mm breech, recoil mechanism and gun carriage.
This gun is a terrific ambush gun, even at longer ranges like 1000 m. Note that it does NOT have any sort of range adjustmenting recticle, so offline practice is recommended until you get a good feel for how the shots drop at longer ranges. Against tanks, you needn't worry too much about shot angle as long as the target is 1 k or less away; it can manage even Tigers at that range. At much longer ranges the medium class tanks like the Panzer IIIs and IVs will be a great deal easier to penetrate even out to 1.5 - 2 km.
Heavily armored frontal beasts (like the StuG's and the Tiger) should not be engaged from the frontal aspect outside 1,000 meters. You really shouldn't open up at long ranges on anything really, not because it won't work (as it will on a lot of tanks, just make sure you know your target!), but because the best AT gunners, like the real guys in the real war, always waited until they had a "sure shot" using the element of surprise, going for the "one shot" kill.
content.brief: TYPE: Heavy Anti-Tank Gun CALIBER: 3 in (76.2 mm) MUZZLE VELOCITY: 793 m/s EFFECTIVE RANGE: 2,500 m WEIGHT: 2,525 kg TOWING CLASS: Heavy
